introZh: 智谱 GLM 团队的开源旗舰模型系列，技术报告标题直接就叫「GLM-5: from Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering」——它不只是一款模型，而是一整套为 Agent 开发 / 复杂系统工程 / 长程任务设计的模型家族（GLM-5 / 5.1 / 5.2），并附本地部署与微调文档。它从 744B 参数、28.5T token 预训练到 DeepSeek Sparse Attention（DSA），强调在长程代理任务上持续保持产出，而不是只追求一次性的首轮正确率。
introEn: Zhipu GLM's open-source flagship model series — the technical report is literally titled 'GLM-5: from Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering'. It is not a single model but a family (GLM-5 / 5.1 / 5.2) purpose-built for agent development, complex systems engineering and long-horizon tasks, shipped with local deployment and fine-tuning docs. From 744B parameters and 28.5T pretraining tokens to DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA), it stresses sustained productivity on long agentic tasks rather than one-shot first-pass accuracy.
audienceZh: 想用开源模型做 Agent / 复杂系统工程、或想对比开源模型与前沿闭源模型在长程任务上差距的开发者与研究者。
audienceEn: Developers and researchers who want an open-source model for agentic and complex systems engineering, or who want to compare open models against frontier closed models on long-horizon tasks.

sectionsZh.title: GLM-5 是什么：为「Agent 工程」而生的模型系列
sectionsZh.body: GLM-5 不是教程而是模型 + 部署文档：技术报告题目就叫 From Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering。GLM-5 相比 GLM-4.5 从 355B 参数（32B active）扩展到 744B 参数（40B active），预训练数据从 23T 增到 28.5T token，并集成 DeepSeek Sparse Attention 以降低部署成本、保住长上下文能力。它定位复杂系统工程与长程 Agent 任务，在 CC-Bench-V2 上显著超过 GLM-4.7，逼近 Claude Opus 4.5。

sectionsZh.title: 「From Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering」如何落地
sectionsZh.body: GLM-5.1 的核心卖点不是首次生成效果，而是长程任务上的持续有效性：把复杂问题拆解、跑实验、读结果、精确定位阻塞点，通过反复迭代修正策略，能在数百轮、数千次工具调用上维持优化——跑得越久结果越好。GLM-5 在 Vending Bench 2（模拟经营一年期的售货机生意）上开源模型第一，期末账户余额 4,432 美元，逼近 Claude Opus 4.5，体现长期规划与资源管理能力。

sectionsZh.title: 三代模型的分工：GLM-5 / 5.1 / 5.2
sectionsZh.body: GLM-5 面向复杂系统工程与长程 Agent 任务；GLM-5.1 是 agentic engineering 旗舰，在 SWE-Bench Pro 上 SOTA，并在 NL2Repo（仓库生成）和 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上大幅领先 GLM-5；GLM-5.2 则是长程任务旗舰，首次提供稳定的 1M token 上下文，编码能力分多档思考强度可调，并引入 IndexShare 架构（每四层稀疏注意力共享同一 indexer，1M 上下文下每 token FLOPs 降 2.9 倍）。在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上 5.2 拿下 81.0（对比 5.1 的 62.0），距闭源前沿 Claude Opus 4.8 的 85.0 仅数分之差。

sectionsZh.title: 本地部署：多框架支持 + 思考预算控制
sectionsZh.body: 模型提供 BF16 与 FP8 精度权重（744B-A40B），支持 SGLang、vLLM、Transformers、KTransformers、Unsloth 等推理框架，Ascend NPU 平台也通过 vLLM-Ascend / xLLM / SGLang 支持。GLM-5 通过 reasoning_effort 参数控制思考预算，max 为默认、high 需显式传入（enable_thinking=false 可完全关闭思考）；复现 benchmark 保持默认 max 即可。

sectionsZh.title: 微调：异步 RL 基建 Slime + ms-swift
sectionsZh.body: 仓库给出两条微调路径：Slime 是 GLM 团队自研的异步强化学习基建，大幅提升训练吞吐与效率，使更细粒度的后训练迭代成为可能；ms-swift 支持 SFT、PPO、GRPO。想复现论文实验或做领域适配，官方提供了 Hugging Face 与 ModelScope 双平台权重下载。

sectionsEn.title: What GLM-5 is: a model family built for 'agentic engineering'
sectionsEn.body: GLM-5 is a model + deployment guide rather than a tutorial — the technical report is titled 'From Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering'. Scaling from 355B (32B active) to 744B parameters (40B active) with pretraining data growing from 23T to 28.5T tokens, GLM-5 integrates DeepSeek Sparse Attention to cut deployment cost while preserving long-context capacity. Purpose-built for complex systems engineering and long-horizon agentic tasks, it significantly outperforms GLM-4.7 on CC-Bench-V2 and narrows the gap to Claude Opus 4.5.

sectionsEn.title: How 'from Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering' lands
sectionsEn.body: GLM-5.1's core selling point is not first-pass quality but sustained effectiveness on long-horizon tasks: it decomposes complex problems, runs experiments, reads results and pinpoints blockers, then revises its strategy through repeated iteration — sustaining optimization over hundreds of rounds and thousands of tool calls. The longer it runs, the better the result. GLM-5 ranks #1 among open-source models on Vending Bench 2 (running a simulated vending-machine business over a one-year horizon) with a final account balance of $4,432, approaching Claude Opus 4.5 and showing long-term planning and resource management.

sectionsEn.title: Three generations, three jobs: GLM-5 / 5.1 / 5.2
sectionsEn.body: GLM-5 targets complex systems engineering and long-horizon agentic tasks; GLM-5.1 is the agentic-engineering flagship with SOTA on SWE-Bench Pro and a wide margin over GLM-5 on NL2Repo (repo generation) and Terminal-Bench 2.0; GLM-5.2 is the long-horizon flagship, delivering a solid 1M-token context for the first time, coding with multiple thinking-effort levels, and an IndexShare architecture that reuses one indexer across every four sparse-attention layers (2.9× fewer FLOPs per token at 1M context). On Terminal-Bench 2.1, 5.2 scores 81.0 (vs. 5.1's 62.0) — within a few points of closed-source frontier Claude Opus 4.8's 85.0.

sectionsEn.title: Local deployment: multi-framework support + thinking-budget control
sectionsEn.body: Weights ship in BF16 and FP8 (744B-A40B) and run on SGLang, vLLM, Transformers, KTransformers, Unsloth and more, with Ascend NPU supported via vLLM-Ascend / xLLM / SGLang. The reasoning_effort parameter controls the thinking budget — max is the default, high must be passed explicitly, and enable_thinking=false turns thinking off entirely. Keep the default max to reproduce benchmark/leaderboard results.

sectionsEn.title: Fine-tuning: asynchronous RL infra Slime + ms-swift
sectionsEn.body: The repo documents two fine-tuning paths: Slime is the GLM team's own asynchronous RL infrastructure, substantially improving training throughput and enabling finer-grained post-training iterations; ms-swift supports SFT, PPO and GRPO. For reproducing paper experiments or domain adaptation, official weights are on both Hugging Face and ModelScope.

practiceZh: 在 Hugging Face 或 ModelScope 下载对应精度（BF16 / FP8）的权重，用 SGLang 或 vLLM 起本地推理，拿一条长程 Agent 任务实测它的持续产出能力。
并行对比 GLM-5 / 5.1 / 5.2 三代的定位差异，体会「首次正确率」与「长程保持产出」是两件不同的事。
调 reasoning_effort（max / high）与 enable_thinking=false，实测不同思考预算下的延迟与质量权衡；复现 benchmark 时保持默认 max。
读一遍技术报告里的 Vending Bench 2 与 Terminal-Bench 2.1 结果，理解「agentic engineering」与「vibe coding」在评估口径上的区别。
practiceEn: Download the weights (BF16 / FP8) from Hugging Face or ModelScope, serve locally with SGLang or vLLM, and test sustained output on one long-horizon agentic task.
Compare GLM-5 / 5.1 / 5.2 side by side to see that first-pass accuracy and sustained long-horizon productivity are two different things.
Tune reasoning_effort (max / high) and enable_thinking=false to measure the latency/quality trade-off at different thinking budgets; keep default max when reproducing benchmarks.
Read the Vending Bench 2 and Terminal-Bench 2.1 results in the technical report to see how 'agentic engineering' differs from 'vibe coding' in evaluation design.
